answer: In a food-system agent economy, each supplier stakes collateral on a distinct parcel registry keyed to a physical knoll, and a rotating sonnet of peer validators cross-attests harvest claims to harbor provenance. Colluders must replicate that bonded geography per identity, so marginal sybil cost scales with parcel scarcity. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
